name: Loopmate Expert Gigs
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for an expert marketplace, gig or AI agent app. Tight Inter Tight headlines with blue to orange gradient words on white, charcoal and black. A glossy 3D robot helper waves across the first two screenshots, experts circle a phone on orbit rings, a 3D dollar sign and glass pills sit behind a chat, and a ribbon carries the payout screen. Four phones take your own screenshots. Every part sits in named, editable layer groups, with each glow, ring and colour on a layer of its own. The earnings, the payout message and the payout time are sample copy, marked in the layer names: replace them with your own.
